text:
emily: Heads-up — opened a tiny docs PR to add runtime compatibility notes for Aegis2 and to fix the benchmark link that was 404: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
raj: on it, can you paste the exact bench link you want? there were two copies in the catalog card
nina: I skimmed the PR — looks like the 'supported runtimes' frontmatter needs ROCm + CUDA stanzas. also sequence_limit for Aegis2 should be 8192, not 4096.
emily: yes, bench link should be the internal S3 artifact: https://s3-us-west-2.redwood.ai/benchmarks/aegis2/p95_summary.html (not the old docs redirect)
kevin: re: sequence_limit — that change affects the sample SDK snippet that demonstrates chunking. we should update python example to show chunking with `redwood.stream()` fallback.
emily: good catch. I added a small python snippet in the PR but left a TODO for the Go example.
raj: I can update Go this afternoon. also flagging this for content review by @nina and a quick run of the doc linter.
nina: lgtm to content after the min fixes. also please add a short compatibility note: "ROCm builds tested on 4.x kernels; earlier kernels may fail due to driver ABI"
emily: added that sentence to the compat section. left a commit message: "docs: add ROCm note + fix bench link + seq_limit"
docs-bot: build-docs job started for PR #482 — linkcheck running
kevin: pranav from runtime team pinged me — he wants to ensure we don't advertise CVM quant profiles for Aegis2 yet. can we add an explicit 'quantization support' line: "quantization: full int8 supported via qprofile v3 (CUDA); CVM preview only"
emily: added quantization line and a short note pointing to the optimize guide. also linked to the internal quant profile JSON: https://internal.redwood/quant/qprofiles/aegis2-v3.json
raj: pushed the Go snippet and updated the example test. PTAL emily
emily: checking now. quick nit: the code fence in README had smart quotes — changed to straight backticks in the commit.
nina: once docs-bot completes linkcheck, can someone run the smoke render on staging? I want to validate the long sequence example renders without truncation
emily: staging render queued — linkcheck passed, but one anchor to "benchmark methodology" 404s, that's the external partner doc. I replaced anchor with full URL to partner guide.
kevin: approved the content changes.
emily: ok merging after docs-bot finishes final build. will merge PR #482 and then open a tiny follow-up to update changelog with the sequence_limit correction.
raj: great, can you add a short note in the model-catalog changelog so customers see it in the release notes?
emily: will do. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
docs-bot: PR #482 merged by emily at 2025-06-09T15:07:58Z — staging deploy started
kevin: filing a quick runtime ticket to track the CVM preview disclaimers so we don't forget to flip when ready (RT #5123)
emily: added TODO in the card: "remove CVM preview tag after QC pass"
kevin: awesome, thanks.
